---
name: build

# yamllint disable-line rule:truthy
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "*"
  push:
    branches:
      - "main"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: build-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    name: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4

      # every platform docker-push publishes, built without being pushed
      - name: Build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          push: false
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7
          tags: dokku/docker-grafana-graphite:ci

---
name: "bump-version"

# yamllint disable-line rule:truthy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      bump_type:
        description: "Bump type"
        default: "patch"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major

# the tag is pushed with GH_ACCESS_TOKEN, so the workflow's own token only reads
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  bump-version:
    name: bump-version
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ env.GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

      - name: Get Latest Tag
        id: latest-tag
        run: |
          echo GIT_LATEST_TAG="$(git describe --tags "$(git rev-list --tags --max-count=1)")" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Compute Next Tag
        id: next-tag
        uses: docker://ghcr.io/dokku/semver-generator:latest
        with:
          bump: ${{ github.event.inputs.bump_type }}
          input: ${{ steps.latest-tag.outputs.GIT_LATEST_TAG }}

      - name: Create and Push Tag
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'Dokku Bot'
          git config --global user.email no-reply@dokku.com
          git tag "$GIT_NEXT_TAG"
          git push origin "$GIT_NEXT_TAG"
        env:
          GIT_NEXT_TAG: ${{ steps.next-tag.outputs.version }}

name: "lint"

# yamllint disable-line rule:truthy
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:

      - "main"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:

jobs:
  hadolint:
    name: hadolint
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Clone
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Run hadolint
        uses: hadolint/hadolint-action@2332a7b74a6de0dda2e2221d575162eba76ba5e5
        # v1.5.0 => c27bd9edc1e95eed30474db8f295ff5807ebca14

  markdown-lint:
    name: markdown-lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Clone
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Run markdown-lint
        uses: avto-dev/markdown-lint@04d43ee9191307b50935a753da3b775ab695eceb
        # v1.5.0 => 04d43ee9191307b50935a753da3b775ab695eceb
        with:
          config: ".github/linters/.markdown-lint.yaml"
          args: "./README.md"

  shellcheck:
    name: shellcheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Clone
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Run shellcheck
        uses: ludeeus/action-shellcheck@00cae500b08a931fb5698e11e79bfbd38e612a38
        # 1.1.0 => 94e0aab03ca135d11a35e5bfc14e6746dc56e7e9
        env:
          SHELLCHECK_OPTS: -s bash
  shfmt:
    name: shfmt
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Clone
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Run shfmt
        uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
        # v0.3.0 => 7f44869033b40ee4ffe7dc76c87a1bc66e3d025a
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
          SHFMT_OPTS: -l -d -i 2
        with:
          sh_checker_shellcheck_disable: true
          sh_checker_comment: true

  yamllint:
    name: yamllint
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Clone
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Run yamllint
        uses: ibiqlik/action-yamllint@2576378a8e339169678f9939646ee3ee325e845c
        # v3.0.2 => c19bd0523a9011c3a3960fe6640a0882b59af15d
        with:
          config_file: ".github/linters/.yamllint.yaml"

---
name: docker-push

# yamllint disable-line rule:truthy
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["lint"]
    types:
      - completed
  push:
    tags:
      - "*"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: docker-push-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  push-enabled:
    name: push-enabled
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      push-enabled: ${{ steps.check.outputs.push-enabled }}
      docker-image-tag: ${{ steps.check.outputs.docker-image-tag }}
      is-tagged: ${{ steps.check.outputs.is-tagged }}
    steps:
      - name: Check if push allowed
        id: check
        # read from the environment rather than pasted into the script, since a
        # branch name is chosen by whoever opens the pull request
        env:
          WORKFLOW_RUN_HEAD_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
          WORKFLOW_RUN_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          image_tag=latest
          push_enabled=false
          is_tagged=false
          if [[ "$WORKFLOW_RUN_HEAD_BRANCH" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ ]]; then
            echo -e "\u001b[32mDetected semver tag\u001b[0m"
            image_tag="$WORKFLOW_RUN_HEAD_BRANCH"
            push_enabled=true
          elif [[ "$WORKFLOW_RUN_HEAD_BRANCH" == "main" ]]; then
            echo -e "\u001b[32mDetected main branch\u001b[0m"
            push_enabled=false
          elif [[ "$REF_NAME" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ ]]; then
            echo -e "\u001b[32mDetected semver tag\u001b[0m"
            image_tag="$REF_NAME"
            push_enabled=true
            is_tagged=true
          else
            echo "::warning ::Unable to detect semver tag or main branch"
            push_enabled=false
          fi

          if [[ "$is_tagged" == "true" ]]; then
            echo -e "\u001b[32mSkipping lint workflow_run check\u001b[0m"
          else
            if [[ "$WORKFLOW_RUN_CONCLUSION" != 'success' ]]; then
              echo "::warning ::Unable to detect successful lint workflow_run conclusion"
              push_enabled=false
            else
              echo -e "\u001b[32mDetected success lint workflow_run conclusion\u001b[0m"
            fi
          fi

          {
            echo "push-enabled=${push_enabled}"
            echo "docker-image-tag=${image_tag}"
            echo "is-tagged=${is_tagged}"
          } >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  docker-push:
    name: push latest
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: push-enabled
    # creates the github release for a tag
    permissions:
      contents: write
    if: needs.push-enabled.outputs.push-enabled == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Generate docker metadata
        id: docker_meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v6
        with:
          images: dokku/docker-grafana-graphite

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v4
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push
        id: docker_build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          push: ${{ needs.push-enabled.outputs.is-tagged == 'true' }}
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7
          tags: dokku/docker-grafana-graphite:${{ needs.push-enabled.outputs.docker-image-tag }}
          labels: |
            ${{ steps.docker_meta.outputs.labels }}
            org.opencontainers.image.version=${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}

      - name: Image digest
        run: echo ${{ steps.docker_build.outputs.digest }}

      - name: Create Release
        if: needs.push-enabled.outputs.is-tagged == 'true'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v3
        with:
          generate_release_notes: true

      - name: Update Docker Hub Description
        if: needs.push-enabled.outputs.is-tagged == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/dockerhub-description@v5
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

name = "docker-grafana-graphite"
version = "0.0.0"
requires-python = "==3.11.*"
dependencies = [
    "carbon==1.1.10",
    "graphite-web",
    "gunicorn==26.2.0",
    "whisper==1.1.10",
]

[dependency-groups]
# installed with pip before anything else, since uv publishes no image for
# every platform this one is built for
build = [
    "uv==0.13.5",
]

[tool.uv]
package = false
default-groups = []
# built from source so that they install under /opt/graphite
no-binary-package = ["carbon", "graphite-web", "whisper"]

[tool.uv.sources]
# graphite-web's pre-release, which is only published as a tag on github. It
# runs on a supported django and carries security fixes 1.1.10 does not
graphite-web = { git = "https://github.com/graphite-project/graphite-web", tag = "1.2.1-pre2" }

---
version: '2'
services:
  grafana_graphite:
    build: .
    image: kamon/grafana_graphite
    container_name: kamon-grafana-dashboard
    ports:
      - '80:80'
      - '81:81'
      - '8125:8125/udp'
      - '8126:8126'
    volumes:
      - ./data/whisper:/opt/graphite/storage/whisper
      - ./data/grafana:/opt/grafana/data
      - ./log/graphite:/opt/graphite/storage/log

# StatsD + Graphite + Grafana

[![dokku/docker-grafana-graphite](http://dockeri.co/image/dokku/docker-grafana-graphite)](https://registry.hub.docker.com/u/dokku/docker-grafana-graphite/)

This image contains a sensible default configuration of StatsD, Graphite and Grafana. This image is used as a base for [dokku](https://github.com/progrium/dokku) graphite-statsd plugin.

There are two ways for using this image:

## Using the Docker Index

All you need as a prerequisite is having `docker`, `docker-compose`, and `make` installed on your machine. The container exposes the following ports:

- `80`: the Grafana web interface.
- `81`: the Graphite web port
- `2003`: the Carbon port.
- `8125`: the StatsD port.
- `8126`: the StatsD administrative port.

To start a container with this image you just need to run the following command:

```bash
make up
```

To stop the container

```bash
make down
```

To run container's shell

```bash
make shell
```

To view the container log

```bash
make tail
```

If you already have services running on your host that are using any of these ports, you may wish to map the container
ports to whatever you want by changing left side number in the `--publish` parameters. You can omit ports you do not plan to use. Find more details about mapping ports in the Docker documentation on [Binding container ports to the host](https://docs.docker.com/engine/userguide/networking/default_network/binding/) and [Legacy container links](https://docs.docker.com/engine/userguide/networking/default_network/dockerlinks/).

## Building the image yourself

The Dockerfile and supporting configuration files are available in our [Github repository](https://github.com/jlachowski/docker-grafana-graphite).
This comes specially handy if you want to change any of the StatsD, Graphite or Grafana settings, or simply if you want
to know how tha image was built. The repo also has `build` and `start` scripts to make your workflow more pleasant.

## Using the Dashboards

Once your container is running all you need to do is:

- open your browser pointing to [http://localhost:80](http://localhost:80) (or another port if you changed it)
  - Docker with VirtualBox on macOS: use `docker-machine ip` instead of `localhost`
- login with the default username (admin) and password (admin)
- open existing dashboard (or create a new one) and select 'Local Graphite' datasource
- play with the dashboard at your wish...

## Persisted Data

When running `make up`, directories are created on your host and mounted into the Docker container, allowing graphite and grafana to persist data and settings between runs of the container.

The container keeps its data in the following paths:

- `/opt/grafana/data`: grafana's database, with its dashboards, users and datasources, and the plugins installed into it
- `/opt/graphite/storage/whisper`: the metrics carbon has written
- `/opt/graphite/storage/graphite.db`: graphite-web's database
- `/opt/graphite/conf`: carbon's configuration, including its storage schemas

A `graphite.db` made by an older release is migrated when the container starts, keeping its contents.

## Now go explore

We hope that you have a lot of fun with this image and that it serves it's
purpose of making your life easier.

"""
Prepares a database made by graphite-web 0.9 for `migrate --fake-initial`.

graphite-web 0.9 created its tables with syncdb, without recording any
migrations. --fake-initial records an app's initial migration as applied
when every table it creates is already there, but graphite-web 1.1's initial
migrations create some tables 0.9 never had, such as dashboard_template, and
so are run instead and fail on the tables that do exist.

For each initial migration that is not recorded but has some of its tables in
the database, the tables it is missing are created as that migration would
create them, leaving every existing table and row as it is.
"""
import os

import django

os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "graphite.settings")
django.setup()

from django.db import connection  # noqa: E402
from django.db.migrations.loader import MigrationLoader  # noqa: E402


def models_created_by(migration):
    for operation in migration.operations:
        if operation.__class__.__name__ == "CreateModel":
            yield operation.name_lower


def tables_for(model):
    """the model's table, and the tables of the many-to-many fields it owns"""
    yield model._meta.db_table, model
    for field in model._meta.local_many_to_many:
        through = field.remote_field.through
        if through._meta.auto_created:
            yield through._meta.db_table, through


def main():
    loader = MigrationLoader(connection)
    existing = set(connection.introspection.table_names())

    for key, migration in sorted(loader.disk_migrations.items()):
        if not getattr(migration, "initial", False) or key in loader.applied_migrations:
            continue

        state = loader.project_state(key, at_end=True)
        app_label = key[0]
        tables = []
        for name in models_created_by(migration):
            tables.extend(tables_for(state.apps.get_model(app_label, name)))

        present = [table for table, _ in tables if table in existing]
        missing = [(table, model) for table, model in tables if table not in existing]
        if not present or not missing:
            continue

        with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
            for table, model in missing:
                print("creating {0} for {1}.{2}".format(table, app_label, key[1]))
                if model._meta.auto_created:
                    editor.create_model(model)
                else:
                    # the model's own table alone: its many-to-many tables
                    # are in the list as well, and some may already exist
                    sql, params = editor.table_sql(model)
                    editor.execute(sql, params or None)
                    editor.deferred_sql.extend(editor._model_indexes_sql(model))
                existing.add(table)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FROM     grafana/grafana:13.2.4-ubuntu AS grafana

FROM     python:3.11-bookworm AS base

# ---------------- #
#   Installation   #
# ---------------- #

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install all prerequisites
RUN apt-get -y update && \
    apt-get -y install supervisor nginx-light build-essential

# Grafana, copied from its own ubuntu image, whose binary is built against
# glibc as this one is. See https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/installation/docker/
COPY --from=grafana /usr/share/grafana /usr/share/grafana
RUN ln -s /usr/share/grafana/bin/grafana /usr/local/bin/grafana && \
    mkdir -p /opt/grafana/data

# The official original statsd package https://www.npmjs.com/package/statsd
COPY ./statsd/package.json ./statsd/package-lock.json /src/statsd/
RUN apt-get -y install nodejs npm && \
    npm ci --omit=dev --prefix /src/statsd

# See https://github.com/graphite-project/graphite-web/blob/1.1.x/docs/install-pip.rst
# Graphite is installed into site-packages, without the /opt/graphite prefix it
# otherwise builds into its packages, and is pointed at /opt/graphite for its
# configuration and data instead
ENV GRAPHITE_NO_PREFIX=1 \
    GRAPHITE_ROOT=/opt/graphite \
    GRAPHITE_CONF_DIR=/opt/graphite/conf \
    GRAPHITE_STORAGE_DIR=/opt/graphite/storage \
    GRAPHITE_SETTINGS_MODULE=local_settings \
    PYTHONPATH=/opt/graphite/webapp
# Bytecode is compiled here, for the packages and for the standard library the
# python image ships without it, so that nothing is written into the container
# as it runs
ENV UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/usr/local \
    UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1
COPY ./pyproject.toml ./uv.lock /src/python/
# uv is installed with pip since it publishes no image for arm/v7. Its version
# is the one pinned in pyproject.toml's build group, where dependabot bumps it
# hadolint ignore=DL3013
RUN apt-get -y install libffi-dev libcairo2 && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir "$(grep -o '"uv==[^"]*"' /src/python/pyproject.toml | tr -d '"')" && \
    uv sync --project /src/python --locked --no-dev --inexact --no-cache && \
    python3 -m compileall -q "$(python3 -c 'import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_path("stdlib"))')"

# ----------------- #
#   Configuration   #
# ----------------- #

FROM base

# Confiure StatsD
COPY    ./statsd/config.js /src/statsd/config.js

# Configure Whisper, Carbon and Graphite-Web
COPY ./graphite/local_settings.py /opt/graphite/webapp/local_settings.py
COPY ./graphite/prepare-database.py /src/graphite/prepare-database.py
COPY ./graphite/carbon.conf /opt/graphite/conf/carbon.conf
COPY ./graphite/storage-schemas.conf /opt/graphite/conf/storage-schemas.conf
COPY ./graphite/storage-aggregation.conf /opt/graphite/conf/storage-aggregation.conf
# graphite-web's static content is installed beside the interpreter, and is
# linked where nginx serves it from
RUN ln -s "$(python3 -c 'import sys; print(sys.prefix)')/webapp/content" /opt/graphite/webapp/content && \
    mkdir -p /opt/graphite/storage/whisper /opt/graphite/storage/log/webapp && \
    touch /opt/graphite/storage/graphite.db /opt/graphite/storage/index && \
    chown -R www-data /opt/graphite/storage && \
    chmod 0775 /opt/graphite/storage /opt/graphite/storage/whisper && \
    chmod 0664 /opt/graphite/storage/graphite.db && \
    django-admin migrate --noinput --settings=graphite.settings

# Configure Grafana
COPY    ./grafana/custom.ini /etc/grafana/grafana.ini

# Add the default dashboards
RUN     mkdir /src/dashboards
COPY    ./grafana/dashboards/* /src/dashboards/
COPY    ./grafana/set-local-graphite-source.sh /src/
RUN     mkdir /src/dashboard-loader
COPY    ./grafana/dashboard-loader/dashboard-loader.js /src/dashboard-loader/

# Configure nginx and supervisord
COPY    ./nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
COPY    ./nginx/start-nginx.sh /src/start-nginx.sh
COPY    ./supervisord.conf /etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf


# ---------------- #
#   Expose Ports   #
# ---------------- #

# Grafana
EXPOSE  80

# Graphite
EXPOSE 2003

# StatsD UDP port
EXPOSE  8125/udp

# StatsD Management port
EXPOSE  8126

# Graphite web port
EXPOSE 81



# -------- #
#   Run!   #
# -------- #

CMD     ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf"]

;http_addr =

;domain = localhost

;router_logging = false

#
# grafana is not waited for: the first time it starts it creates its database,
# which can take minutes, and until it is up its port answers with a bad gateway
until curl -fsS -o /dev/null 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/metrics/find?query=*'; do
  sleep 1
done

exec /usr/sbin/nginx
